features: 1T (1 TOPS) AI computing power for human and vehicle detection
Smart dual light (white light & IR) day/night switching
DWDR, 3D noise reduction, backlight compensation, automatic white balance
Intrusion detection, tripwire detection, off-duty detection, passenger flow statistics
Available as E3U-4LRV(2.8) AI-P (PoE only) or AI-PD (PoE & DC) variants
release_notes: The datasheet's Dimension diagram (page 4) depicts a bullet-camera housing with a sunshade and separate mounting arm (179mm length, 67.2mm width), which is inconsistent with the turret/eyeball form factor shown in the product photo and named in the title ('4MP Dual Light Turret Camera'). This appears to be a copy-paste error from a different product's datasheet, so dimensions_mm and weight_g were omitted rather than guessed.
